provider_evidence_records.field_family: SEC EDGAR submissions, complete-submission timestamps, extracted XBRL company facts, and observed-date reconstruction inputs.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://www.sec.gov/edgar/sec-api-documentation. Official SEC documentation says data.sec.gov provides submissions history and extracted XBRL data, including submissions by filer and companyfacts/companyconcept APIs, updated as submissions are disseminated. This supports a public-source reconstruction candidate, not a complete field-level production provider.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://www.sec.gov/about/webmaster-faq.htm. Official SEC FAQ documents EDGAR timestamp semantics including ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME in complete submission text, filed-as-of date, and acceptance date. This supports observed-date reconstruction requirements but still leaves parsing, restatement, extension-taxonomy, and coverage validation open.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://www.sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/accessing-edgar-data.htm. Official SEC documentation covers EDGAR public access, fair access, indexes, post-acceptance corrections and deletions, and data APIs. This is necessary lineage context for a public EDGAR path, not approval for a local DataHub implementation.

missing_required_evidence: Field-level PIT reconstruction rule that maps each XBRL fact to filing accession, acceptance timestamp, fiscal period, unit, amendment, and restatement handling.
Coverage counts across the intended US investable universe, historical backtest window, forms, statement families, and taxonomy coverage.
CIK / ticker / exchange / listing-state linking policy that avoids survivorship leakage and records delistings, ticker changes, ADRs, SPACs, ETFs, and duplicates.
Parser validation for company-specific taxonomy extensions, amended filings, post-acceptance corrections, missing facts, and changed units.
Fair-access, retry, cache, and incident policy before any automated fetch.
limitations: SEC EDGAR is a public source, not a normalized fundamentals provider; implementation still needs a reviewed parser and data contract.
Extracted XBRL companyfacts are not automatically PIT-safe factor inputs without accession-level observed-date reconstruction and amendment handling.
This record performs no API calls and does not create a provider adapter or DataHub table.

provider_evidence_records.field_family: Intrinio filing-linked fundamentals, fundamental IDs, filing date, accepted date, latest flag, and updated date candidate evidence.

evidence_source_refs.source_title: Intrinio All Fundamentals by Filing API
evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://docs.intrinio.com/documentation/web_api/get_filing_fundamentals_v2. Intrinio documentation describes fundamentals tied to a filing identifier and output fields including fundamental ID, statement code, fiscal year/period, filing_date, is_latest, updated_date, and nested filing accepted_date. This is strong observed-date candidate evidence, not provider selection.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://docs.intrinio.com/documentation/api_v2/getting_started. Intrinio documents authenticated JSON APIs and standardized / as-reported financial statement endpoint families. Authentication, tier, coverage, license, quota, and field semantics still require separate review.

missing_required_evidence: Paid tier, local-storage, private derived report, non-display research, retention, and redistribution permissions.
Coverage counts by ticker/CIK, fiscal year, statement type, report type, and active/delisted universe.
Exact historical PIT semantics for as-reported vs standardized financials, amended filings, restatements, is_latest behavior, and updated_date revisions.
Security master, delisting, corporate action, benchmark, and GICS linkage if Intrinio is used beyond filing fundamentals.
Direct endpoint trial or sample-row validation before any implementation contract consumes this candidate.
limitations: Documentation-level accepted_date support is not the same as verified PIT factor construction across the project universe.
No Intrinio data was fetched and no subscription, trial, or paid tier was approved.
The candidate remains blocked until license, coverage, revision, fallback, and stability evidence are reviewed.

provider_evidence_records.field_family: Financial Modeling Prep SEC filing, as-reported financial statement, cycle-time, and latest-filings candidate evidence.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs/stable/financials-latest. FMP documentation describes latest SEC filing access, real-time updates as filings are accepted, and the sec-filings-financials endpoint. The page is latest-filings oriented and does not by itself prove historical PIT financial statement factors.

evidence_source_refs.source_title: FMP Developer Docs Financial Statements As Reported
evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs. FMP documentation lists as-reported income, balance sheet, cash flow, and full financial statement endpoints plus SEC filing search endpoints. This is candidate endpoint evidence only; accepted-date linkage, historical PIT eligibility, and field-level revisions still need review.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs/cycle-times. FMP cycle-time documentation says financial statements and as-reported statements are available when published on the SEC, from minutes to hours, and SEC filings when published on the SEC. This is freshness evidence, not complete PIT or license evidence.

missing_required_evidence: Proof that historical financial-statement rows carry filing accepted date or another reviewed as-of eligibility timestamp.
Proof that latest or current endpoints are not used to backfill historical evidence.
Coverage counts by symbol/CIK, form type, fiscal period, historical date range, and active/delisted population.
License, local-storage, private derived report, quota, cost, and retention terms.
Revision, amendment, restatement, endpoint field dictionary, and fallback behavior review.
limitations: FMP latest-filings and current financial endpoints cannot be treated as PIT historical fundamentals without accepted-date linkage.
This record does not approve FMP provider selection, paid access, or data fetching.
Freshness claims are not a substitute for coverage, license, stability, and field-level revision evidence.
